exposure: awareness of maternal health programs (NIS, PMMVY, ICDS, PMSMA, JSY, JSSK)
utilization of maternal health programs (ICDS, PMSMA, JSY, JSSK, PMMVY)
cohort: 250 post-mothers residing in a rural area of Saharanpur, India, selected using multistage random sampling.
finding: Awareness and utilization of maternal health programs were high, and the utilization of JSY, JSSK, and PMMVY services was significantly associated with higher chances of normal delivery.
mod_finding: Utilization of JSY, JSSK, and PMMVY services was associated with higher chances of normal delivery.
